sentences.text:
And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Rizwanul Haque Ansari,Santi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of complainant despite service of notice.
2. It is argued by the counsel for the applicant that F.I.R. was lodged under Section 376 IPC read with other sections.
He submits that during trial, victim has turned hostile and she has not supported the prosecution story, the statement is on record.
Applicant is jail since 20.09.2023 however, he has no criminal history.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.
Muneer Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.

4. Considering the fact that victim has turned hostile and has not supported the prosecution story,
applicant in custody since 20.09.2023 having no criminal history and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant- Muneer Ali be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.178 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) IPC and Section 5j(II)/6 POCSO Act and Section 3(2)5 of SC/ST Act,
Police Station Singahi, District Lakhimpur Kheri, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Saurabh Yadav/-
